question: The average weight of Mohan, Mohammad and Ashish is 45 kg. If the average weight of Mohan and Mohammad be 43 kg and that of Mohammad and Ashish be 46 kg, then the weight of Mohammad (in kg) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Weight of Mohammad = (Total weight of Mohan & Mohammad) + (Total weight of Mohammad & Ashish) − (Total weight of all three)

⇒ Mohammad's weight = (2 × 43) + (2 × 46) − (3 × 45)

⇒ Mohammad's weight = 86 + 92 − 135

⇒ Mohammad's weight = 178 − 135 = 43 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 43 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average weight of Mohan, Mohammad and Ashish = 45 kg

Average weight of Mohan and Mohammad = 43 kg

Average weight of Mohammad and Ashish = 46 kg
